title: An immersion cancels from a composite
statement: Let $X,Y,T$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $f:X\to Y$ and $g:Y\to T$ be morphisms. If $g\circ f$ is an immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion], then $f$ is an immersion. No separatedness or quasi-compactness assumption is imposed.
